en.text:
On 3 Precision Hits within 6 seconds of each:
• Grants x1 <arc/>Bolt Charge
• Summons a lightning strike after 1.1 seconds, dealing <arc/><pve 973 /> <pvp [300] /> damage in a 7 meter radius
• Summons a lightning storm 0.5 seconds later, dealing <arc/><pve 584 /> <pvp [180] /> damage in a spread-X pattern in a 5 meter radius. 

Lightning storm staggers enemies and deals 25% damage at the edge of its radius. Enemies can only take damage from the storm once.

Precision Hit progress is removed on stow.
